root_cause: Two mechanisms. (1) Every DM publish called NDKEvent.publish() without a timeout, so NDK 3.0.3's 2500 ms per-relay ack default applied (groups use 10 s); a late ack on a loaded machine rolled back a message the relay had stored. (2) The observed e2e signature (bubble gone, no failure notice, empty composer) was ContactChat's thread-open seed: own DMs are persisted only after the relay ack and there is no self-wrap, and the init effect replaced state with setMessages(filterVisibleMessages(stored)) (setMessages([]) on error), erasing a send made before that IDB read resolved.
fix: ndkClient.ts: shared PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS (10 s) + publishWithTimeout, used by all DM publish sites and as NdkNetworkAdapter.rawPublish's default; directMessages.ts publishPrebuiltRumor for ContactChat's text/reaction sends. ChatBox: on a failed text send a 'Failed to send message' notice with Retry; the text returns to the composer of the thread it was sent in (per-thread stash, never into an active edit/caption). ContactChat: seedThreadMessages merges storage into same-thread rendered rows for the seed and the error branch; ContactChat keyed by account pubkey at both render sites.

tests_added.kinds: real-NDK fake-timer late-ack (4.5 s) tests per DM publish site; failed-send reducer/stash/restore pure helpers; seedThreadMessages merge cases

e2e.result: non-relay 72 passed; relay 349 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed; no INVALID marker
e2e.previous_gate: full-dmpub.log: 2 failed (AC-60 seed race -> fixed in round 5; dm-block-contact :146 KeyPackage-not-found load flake, passed in the green rerun)

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The handoff asked to confirm the publish-rejection mechanism with a log first; it never reproduced under load, so the fix rested on the NDK source. The first full gate showed the real e2e signature (no failure notice) pointed at a second cause, costing an extra ~65-minute gate on the 1-CPU VM.
retrospective.surprised_by: Own DMs exist only in React state until the ack (no self-wrap), so any blind state replace silently loses them; ChatBox/ContactChat are not keyed by thread, which made the failed-send restore a cross-thread privacy trap.
lead_clarifications: Failed-send UX decided by Fable (AGENT-DECIDES): inline notice + Retry, DMs and groups alike.
